# Usage oracle fixture home (`B0-4`)

Sanitized, fully synthetic home directory used as `USERPROFILE` to generate the
TokenTracker (TT) queue baseline that Highlighter's usage store is compared
against. **No real prompt, response, code, path, session id or DB row is copied
here** — every record is hand-built structural JSON carrying token counters only.

- Size: **~34 KiB total** (`du -sh test/fixtures/usage/home` ≈ 36K); the real
  sources are ~1.2 GB (`~/.codex/sessions` 420 MB / `~/.dsh/sessions` 70 MB /
  `opencode.db` 754 MB), so the real files are never copied.
- Shape wins come from inspecting the real files read-only on the dev box
  (2026-10-21): record types/keys and the Codex/DSH/OpenCode token field layouts
  are matched, the bodies are synthetic.
- Generated by `node scripts/usage-oracle-check.js --build-fixtures`
  (deterministic; re-running produces byte-identical fixture inputs).

## Layout

| Path | Inspired by (real, read-only) | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `.codex/sessions/2026/03/14/rollout-…0001.jsonl` | `C:\Users\24532\.codex\sessions\2026\07\01\rollout-2026-07-01T08-51-22-019f1b28…jsonl` (32 KB, 12 lines) | `session_meta` + `turn_context` + two cumulative `event_msg/token_count` snapshots (one bucket) + `task_complete` |
| `.codex/sessions/2026/03/14/rollout-…0002.jsonl` | same shape | second model (`gpt-5.2`), one complete `token_count`, then a **torn final record** (no newline/close) and a malformed terminated line — neither may contribute usage |
| `.codex/sessions/2026/03/15/rollout-…0003.jsonl` | same shape | token events crossing the UTC day boundary (`23:50` → next `00:10`) |
| `.dsh/sessions/--fixtures-dsh-project--/session-…0011/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` | `C:\Users\24532\.dsh\sessions\--D-workspace-Highlighter--\session-54aada96…\session.v4.jsonl.zstd` (44 KB, 66 records) | v4 `session` header + `request/header` + two `assistant/message` records with `data.usage`; one zstd frame per appended record |
| `.dsh/sessions/--fixtures-dsh-project--/session-…0012/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` | same shape | second model (`deepseek-v4.1-pro`), one usage record |
| `.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` | `C:\Users\24532\.local\share\opencode\opencode.db` (754 MB) | synthetic SQLite: `message` (v1 generation, flat `modelID`), `session_message` + `session_v2` (v2 beta generation, nested `model {id, providerID}`), one `user` row and zero-token rows that must be ignored |

`AppData/` is created empty by the oracle sync env override only if TT writes
there; it is not committed.

## Redaction / provenance rules

- Record **types**, **key names**, **field ordering**, **timestamp formats** and
  **token field semantics** follow the real logs (verified against the real
  files read-only via `node:zlib` zstd decoding and `node:sqlite`).
- All identifiers are fixed placeholders (`00000000-…`, `msg_fixture_*`,
  `ses_fixture_*`), all paths are `C:\fixtures\…` / `D:\fixtures\…`, all message
  bodies are the literal `"fixture"`.
- Token numbers are synthetic round values chosen to exercise: cumulative
  snapshot diffing (Codex), cache read/write split, reasoning split, half-hour
  bucketing, UTC day boundary, v1↔v2 OpenCode generation, torn/malformed lines.
- `.tokentracker/` (TT sync scratch: `queue.jsonl`, `cursors.json`, …) is
  git-ignored; regenerate with `--sync`.

## Regenerate + generate golden

```bash
# 1) one-time, OUTSIDE this repo: TokenTracker CLI v1.4.7 oracle install
#    (never added to product dependencies; do not commit)
mkdir -p D:/workspace/_tt-oracle && cd D:/workspace/_tt-oracle
npm init -y
npm i --ignore-scripts tokentracker-cli@1.4.7
node node_modules/tokentracker-cli/bin/tracker.js --version

# 2) rebuild fixtures (deterministic, ~34 KiB)
node scripts/usage-oracle-check.js --build-fixtures

# 3) run TT sync against this fake home and write the golden baseline
node scripts/usage-oracle-check.js --tt-only --sync
#    => test/fixtures/usage/golden/queue-rows.json  (11 bucket rows)
#    => test/fixtures/usage/golden/summary.json     (per-source/per-model daily sums)

# 4) later, once the Highlighter usage store exists:
node scripts/usage-oracle-check.js --hl-db <dataRoot>/usage/usage.db
```

Observed oracle sync output (2026-10-21, TT v1.4.7, Windows):

```
Sync finished:
- Parsed files: 9
- New 30-min buckets queued: 11
- Uploaded: skipped (no device token)
```

Local-only guarantees of the oracle run (implemented in
`scripts/usage-oracle-check.js`):

- `USERPROFILE`/`HOME` → fixture home; `APPDATA`/`LOCALAPPDATA` → fixture home
  subdirs (some TT resolvers read these directly and would otherwise parse the
  real user tree).
- `DSH_HOME`, `TOKENTRACKER_DSH_HOME`, `CODEX_HOME`, `XDG_DATA_HOME`,
  `OPENCODE_HOME`, device-token/env overrides removed.
- `TOKENTRACKER_WSL_MODE=native-only` (no `wsl.exe` probe),
  `TOKENTRACKER_NO_TELEMETRY=1`, `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`.
- A fresh fake home has no device token; TT upload is gated on
  `runtime.deviceToken && runtime.baseUrl` (`sync.js`), hence
  `Uploaded: skipped (no device token)` — no `device-login` is ever run.
- The npm package has no `sentry.js`; the only outbound call site reachable from
  `sync` is the anonymous daily heartbeat in `telemetry.js`, which the env flag
  disables. The real `~/.tokentracker/tracker` is never created (verified).

| source | model | hour_start (UTC) | input | cached | cache write | output | reasoning | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| codex | gpt-5.4-codex | 2026-03-14T01:00Z | 7000 | 9000 | 0 | 550 | 150 | 16550 |
| codex | gpt-5.2 | 2026-03-14T02:00Z | 3000 | 2000 | 0 | 400 | 0 | 5400 |
| codex | gpt-5.4-mini | 2026-03-15T23:30Z | 3000 | 3000 | 0 | 200 | 50 | 6200 |
| codex | gpt-5.4-mini | 2026-03-16T00:00Z | 1000 | 1000 | 0 | 100 | 0 | 2100 |
| dsh | deepseek-v4.1-flash | 2026-03-14T03:00Z | 3000 | 1200 | 200 | 400 | 100 | 4900 |
| dsh | deepseek-v4.1-flash | 2026-03-14T03:30Z | 1500 | 800 | 0 | 300 | 40 | 2640 |
| dsh | deepseek-v4.1-pro | 2026-03-15T00:00Z | 5000 | 0 | 0 | 600 | 50 | 5650 |
| opencode | glm-5 | 2026-03-14T04:00Z | 1000 | 300 | 100 | 200 | 50 | 1650 |
| opencode | claude-sonnet-4-5 | 2026-03-14T04:30Z | 2400 | 800 | 0 | 500 | 0 | 3700 |
| opencode | deepseek-v4.1-flash | 2026-03-15T09:00Z | 1800 | 400 | 0 | 260 | 30 | 2490 |
| opencode | deepseek-v4.1-flash | 2026-03-15T09:30Z | 900 | 200 | 50 | 140 | 20 | 1310 |

Codex `input_tokens` is the non-cached input after TT subtracts the cached slice
inside the cumulative `input_tokens` (7,000 = 4,000 + 3,000 from turn 1/2); DSH
and OpenCode store disjoint columns already. `total_tokens` excludes
`cache_creation` for Codex/DSH/OpenCode totals by upstream convention (Codex
`total_token_usage.total_tokens` is `input + output`; DSH/OpenCode totals sum
their five disjoint columns, including cache write for DSH/OpenCode).
